data.body:
Survey checkpoint after the origin refresh.

The survey worktree fast-forwarded cleanly to origin/main commit ae1bc8871273cc861e79161f7f3648b97add9ec6. The new commit adds MCP client configuration examples and docs/mcp-client-setup.md. It does not change the evidence for F50 through F53 or F55. It expands the F54 audience review because the client page directs users through repository deployment artifacts and an internal PAT runbook.

- F50 remains a wording alignment across human force override guidance. It preserves the force capabilities established by linen-contrived-wisent and oozy-cabbagy-tuna.
- F51 remains a README accuracy repair. The detailed publication section and store implementation still define best-effort push with observable local backlog.
- F52 remains a bounded correction of retired flat-configuration and HMAC gate claims. It preserves legacy compatibility, generic HMAC uses, tombstones, migrations, ADRs, and frozen evidence.
- F53 now has explicit destinations. Client setup and supported behavior remain in docs/jira-sync-setup.md. Repository cadence and monitoring operations move to an internal runbook. Fixture guidance consolidates in docs/jira-fixtures.md. Jira Data Center harness procedure remains in tests/external/live_jira_dc/README.md. Historical rollout narrative becomes ticket references.
- F54 is split. F54A covers external MCP authentication and client setup. F54B covers registrar-owned shipped tool descriptions and regeneration of docs/mcp-reference.md.
- F55 remains a separately marked mixed-scope proposal. ultrashort-burnedout-gibbon confirmed that MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY has a producer and transport but no consumer. No implementation or reversal occurred.

The next required step is an independent accuracy and conformance challenge after an agent slot becomes available. No repository files changed.
